- wary_C_cert_cost (k O): PlaysProof (WaryBot k) O (WaryBot k) C n -> k<n. [unfold WaryBot;cases(search_t=>cases hp;search_f=>simp[c_node];omega)]
- wary_optim_A_unprov (k): ∀K φ,Pf K φ->K≤k->TailTo(plays(WaryBot k)(OptimBot k k)C)φ->False. via no_provable_tailToS_floor singleton {A}. => ¬Pf ≤k A, A=plays(WaryBot k)(OptimBot k k)C.
- optim_D_forces (k): ∀n,PlaysProof(OptimBot k k)(WaryBot k)(OptimBot k k)D n -> Pf k A ∨ Pf k D3. [unfold OptimBot;cases 3-deep search_t/search_f; last cases hp3]. D3=plays(WaryBot k)(OptimBot k k)D.
- wary_D_forces (k): ∀n,PlaysProof(WaryBot k)(OptimBot k k)(WaryBot k)D n -> Pf k (neg B). B=plays(OptimBot k k)(WaryBot k)C. [unfold WaryBot;cases(search_t=>simpa..using hg;search_f=>cases hp)]
- LIB optim_C_cert_cost (Theorems/CIMCIC/vs_OptimBot): PlaysProof Optim O Optim C n->k<n.

THE ONE HARD GOAL: ¬ Pf k (neg B). Then WaryBot plays C (eval), then D3 false by soundness, then A false (have), then OptimBot plays C (eval like OptimBot_plays_C_against_CIMCIC), then outcome (C,C).

WHY KERNELS DON'T FIT:
- Floor kernel no_provable_tailToS_floor fails on D3: WaryBot's D IS searchBranch target (const D), hsb obligation FAILS.
- WV master wv_sound_upto forcing B: OptimBot's C reached via SEARCH fall-through (not sim), so WV's sim-only closure (h_sim_inv) can't capture it; OptimBot base h_search_t/f obligations reduce to needing ¬Pf k D3 (D-branches need Pf k A[dead] or Pf k D3) = the census output = circular.
- WaryBot-mirror WV pattern needs partner(MirrorBot) C-play via SIM; OptimBot isn't sim.

CYCLE (proven via lemmas): Pf ≤k (neg B) --atomNeg-->Optim-D-cert--optim_D_forces-->Pf k A(dead by wary_optim_A_unprov)∨Pf k D3. Pf k D3 --tail_plays_readable=>WaryBot searchBranch=> box(neg B)=> Pf k (neg B). Each step -> STRICTLY SMALLER SUB-PROOF (guard premise). So STRUCTURAL induction (Pf.induct) proves ¬(neg B ∨ D3) provable. Budgets all =k (no descent) but proof-TREE descends.

PLAN NOW: custom joint Pf.induct. Motive over Pf K φ: (K ≤ k) → ¬ TailToS {D3, neg B, and helper atoms} φ. Since neg B non-plays, can't use no_provable_tailToS_floor. Need CUSTOM 39-arm induction (kernels don't fit - justified). At atom arm: if AtomProvable concludes D3 => wary_D_forces=>Pf k (neg B); apply IH? no IH on extracted. HARD: extracted sub-proof isn't a Pf.induct subterm.
  KEY OBSTACLE: extracted guard proofs (Pf k neg B from a cert) are NOT sub-terms of the Pf.induct target, so no IH. Need instead: strong induction where the extracted proof is smaller. Pf/PlaysProof have no nat size measure exposed. 

ALTERNATIVE FINAL: Since extraction isn't a subterm, structural Pf.induct won't directly give IH on it. This is the "recursively-closed avoid-set frontier" wall. Genuinely beyond kernels WITHOUT a new size-measure census.

DECISION leaning: verdict open_blocked. Outcome determined (C,C) at eval level; negative census ¬Pf k(neg B) is entangled positive/neg fixpoint where OptimBot's partner-C is search-nested (not sim), so WV sim-closure census inapplicable, floor kernel fails on D3's searchBranch shape, and structural Pf.induct lacks IH on cert-extracted guard proofs.
